description: Runner/operator: finalize one finished run dir under ledger/runs (terminal.json present): run the frozen check into check.json, append the transcript footer, publish-evidence, append the ledger row once (ledger.jsonl scanned for this run's transcript first), then the outbox envelope (<state>/outbox/<run_id>.json), then finalized.json last. terminal.json and the run dir are fsync'd on entry. Rows are row_version 2: error and call_errors from ops/bin/_errors.py when present, stop and verdict unchanged; finalize.error carries class (spool_full on ENOSPC). One exclusive flock on finalize.lock per run; a second finalizer exits 3 with state pending. Publish failure is recorded in finalize.error, lets the row through, and keeps finalized.json absent so tick's sweep retries and tick retries publication. Env FINALIZE_RUN_CRASH_AFTER=check|transcript|publish|row|envelope and FINALIZE_RUN_ENOSPC_BEFORE=row|envelope are TEST-ONLY fault injection. Not a model tool.

run_dir.description: Run directory: an absolute path, or the run's identifier (the row's ledger/runs/<id>, or <id>) resolved under the state root (_roots); must resolve directly under <state>/runs.
